notes.title: Quality of Undeath Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32065038/ce7ff9f9ad40b518ff496f1928605809bad1745a.png[/img]

Our number one most requested feature has always been a stash, where you can store your favourite items, and now it's finally here!

The stash comes with two new helpful skeletons, and a host of other additions, improvements, and fixes.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32065038/37c3d24e6afdd639c43d0209dd885936a6dd2327.png[/img]

Garfield is here to fulfil another common request from the players. He will reset all your upgrade cards for a modest fee, so you can setup a whole new build. Make different choices if you feel like you've focused on the wrong thing, or just pick different cards to try out different builds for the fun of it.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32065038/d07ba0ec47709a6189d7667d0796cb0d0b15394a.png[/img]

If you like to command heroes or other more tanky units, you may have found yourself in a situation where clerics and vampirism just don't cut it when it comes to healing. Pierce will heal all of your units to full health, so long as you produce the coin.

Both our new friends can be rescued from the Catacombs, and will join you in the Crypt, where you will also find the stash.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32065038/bfefeb76b7376f0468c351e03f3c04c9806294f9.png[/img]

The update also includes a couple of new item features, significant performance improvements, balancing tweaks, and general fixes, and quality of life improvements.

Here's a change list:

- Added stash to hub
- Added unit healer (rescuable in catacombs)
- Added upgrade card reseter (rescuable in catacombs)
- Added sceptre of siege (summon crossbowmen)
- Added increased raise area item affix
- Limited protect ring to 95%
- Increased fireball damage scaling
- Blocked chickenify of chickens
- Rarer items in shops in ng+
- Increased scythe damages a bit
- Higher rarity item drops at higher necro levels, and particularly ng+
- When dying, get recently spawned item loot to crypt
- Buffed upgrade card hp and mana rewards
- Made catacomb bridge wider for better AI navigation
- Added alternate summon gfx option
- Added pausing the game when losing focus
- Stats screen scrolling with mouse wheel & small padding at end
- Fixed dialogue screen position align + improved panel texture
- Engine performance improvements
- Slight performance improvement for clerics & goblins AI
- Fixed ground item pos loading bug
- Fixed bug in german translation: unit attack speed was translated as unit attack damage
- Fixed ground normal texture bug
- Added failsafe check for killed buildings in case of rare quest item bug
- Added sanity checks for item level requirement not getting higher than max player level

Now better go rescue our caged undead friends!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32065038/59a9828033749d13fba71997b445b087e8a77e0e.png[/img]

[b]UPDATE:[/b] [b]These features are now in the main branch and the default version.[/b]

Another major addition are the eras 4 & 5. They've been tuned to be more difficult than 2 or 3, but we'd like to have some feedback about that. Should we increase the difficulty more? It's not hardcore at the moment, but we could push it further. Try the beta and send us feedback. We'll keep the 1.1.0 for a while since it has some major changes.

To try this beta, see instructions here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/790850/discussions/0/1837937637904364275/

notes.title: Raise a rabble of bony lads in Undead Horde
notes.notes:
Rowdy meat-free lads have risen from the grave and only you have the will and the power to channel their boisterousness into productive behaviour. That’s Undead Horde, a game about a necromancer raising the dead to rampage across the kingdom for fun and profit. I am only now realising that I’d rolled Undead Horde and Skeletal Dance Party into one game in my memory but no worries. Undead Horde is made by 10tons, the gang behind games including Crimsonland and Jydge, so I guess I’m glad to now be fully aware of it. They make some fun video games.

(more…)

notes.title: Undead Horde Out Today on PC & Consoles
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32065038/7f3230bd36b987aef529a800067f6a993296fb9c.gif[/img]

We've now moved the completed version 1.0.4 as the default version - this marks the full version release. Whee!

Our humble thanks to all the early access customers - with your help we made the game a lot better. We hope you've enjoyed playing the earlier versions as much as we enjoyed creating it.

Even though the game is now completed we still plan to make some major updates. One of our goals is to improve the Era-system and maybe add a couple of new affix abilities - what do you think about "splash damage on raise" effect for example?

In any case, have fun with the game and report any problems to us. We'll try to fix any issues as fast as possible.

notes.title: 1.0.4 RC2 In Beta - Transitioning to Complete Version Tomorrow
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32065038/0f55d28b9b12e824c932d9af21356dd237f2d18a.gif[/img]

Undead Horde can be called complete tomorrow! That said, we will still continue updating the game for some time. We're still not completely done with the era system for example and there are some other things we want to do still. 

Various circumstances have determined our console launch date to be 15th May though and we want to release all platform versions the same day so tomorrow we will launch the "full version". However, bigger updates like era system polishing aren't stopping just yet!  

Also, as planned, the price was increased a bit now that all the content is available (although in beta branch only at the moment - but that'll change soon).

Here are the changes:
[list]
[*] Option to turn off necromancer voice overs
[*] Weakest minions can be banished from the character panel at any time
[*] Fixed some item loot levels in later eras (deed rewards & named items mainly)
[*]  Added missing strings to languages
[*] Era-text is updated on the map when changing era
[*] Secrets & Eras persistency problems fixed
[*] Fixed era urn useability after starting a new game in Era 1
[*] Fixed Benevictor spawner destroy FXs
[*] Made it more difficult for the orcs to start fighting with elementals in Barbarian Stronghold
[/list]

We will fix any major issues reported and move this build as the default tomorrow after some testing. If you want to help us, try out the version in beta now - instructions: https://steamcommunity.com/app/790850/discussions/0/1837937637904364275/

notes.title: 1.0.3 RC1 in Beta Branch!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32065038/0f55d28b9b12e824c932d9af21356dd237f2d18a.gif[/img]

The latest version (1.0.3) is now in beta branch. This version has chapter five open and it can be completed. We're nearing full release so we wanted to open the full game a bit before the actual full release date to get feedback from the era system and the final chapter.

The game can be also replayed in Era 2 and Era 3. The following eras are not necessarily more difficult in early game, but the difficulty level increases as you go. Era 3 hasn't been tested much but it should be the most difficult. We may add more eras if there's demand. We'll also keep balancing the eras as we receive feedback.

If you want to try the final chapter early in beta, here are instructions: https://steamcommunity.com/app/790850/discussions/0/1837937637904364275/

notes.title: Version 0.9.1.3 Live! - More Localization!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32065038/c5a104d484f6c67dcbd58d1475034bdb89a9080e.png[/img]

This version has many new localized languages and we've continued to do some bug fixing as well. There are some missing strings in all languages currently. Spanish and Chinese have most holes at the moment - others have only a small handful as they are more recent. We'll complete the languages in the coming days. 

Short change list:
[list]
[*] Finally tracked down & fixed the "disappearing hired heroes"-bug
[*] Thirsty's note should be highlighted better in inventory for improved discoverability
[*] The game now supports the following languages: Chinese, Spanish, French, German, Finnish, Portuguese (BR), Korean, Japanese and Russian
[*] Added an in-game language menu - you change the language real time.
[*] Misc smaller fixes & changes
[/list]

Next we'll focus in preparing the final fifth chapter for publishing. The fifih chapter will also open a new Era, where you can replay the game from the start with all the units unlocked so far. After that there's still a third era, which is a bit more difficult than the second. All this will be available next week thus completing the game. 

After the game is complete, we will still listen to feedback and do some updating as long as the game stays lively enough. The era-system hasn't been played much yet still, so we'll probably tweak it further with your feedback.

notes.title: Your Feedback in Action - Top Issues Revealed!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32065038/c8a4dc11ba065cbcb4277bc863aee5a181c56a5e.png[/img]

We've gotten a lot of feedback from the forums and from the game feedback form as well. In general people seem to like the game a lot and the game is perceived as "fun" by most of the people: [b]The fun factor from 1-5 is around 4.5 on average[/b]! Thank you!

We're happy that people like the game, but as developers we're mostly interested about the problems players report. Here's a list of top issues reported by the players so far. These are grouped into larger themes so that we can observe the bigger picture. 

Note that, we're also reacting to dozens of smaller items and individual issues. These themes are mentioned here because they have repeated the most in the feedback.

[h1]Walking Times and Run Button[/h1]

A lot of players wanted a run button or shorter walk times. We worked on this issue around the design table and came up with a "necrohover"-system. The system will allow faster movement outside combat. Basically the necromancer starts levitating after traveling uninterrupted for some time. Doing other stuff than traveling or being attacked will interrupt the levitation. We're yet to test this, but on paper it looks promising. 

[h1]Shop Selection Lacking[/h1]

Some players found the shop items lacking or undesirable. The shop systems need some improvement. The current system is very simple and usually doesn't produce desirable items. We are working on improving the shops so that you can "bribe" the merchants to shuffle AND improve the item quality. We'll also increase base item quality. This allows players more control over the shop contents and more desirable items.

[h1]Inventory Too Small & No Stash in Crypt[/h1]

Some players feel that inventory is too small. We'll be adding at least one row more of inventory which should help with the issue. Some players would want a stash of some kind. We're not certain about the stash details yet, but we're thinking about it. 

[h1]Lack of Horde Control or Minions Stuck[/h1]

This  aspect garnered a bunch of comments. Some wanted to pinpoint targets for the horde or control them more individually. Others commented that minions get stuck in places. 

We'll try to address the minions getting stuck issue as well as we can. There's still room for improvement on that front. 

In general we want to keep the horde controls simple and straightforward so that the game doesn't become an RTS and stays playable on gamepads as well. This means we won't be doing massive changes on horde control as it would result in some very different game. That said, we'll keep working on the unit AI to make it as fun as possible. Please report to us any cases where the horde does something which frustrates you - we might be able to tweak it so that it doesn't do that.

[h1]Too Few Weapons or Spells[/h1]

Some players felt there should be more weapons and spells. We'll be adding more spells and affixes as we go so this area will improve as we develop. We'll also improve the damage of slower weapons to differentiate them and tweak the affix systems so that players would get more interesting weapons.

[h1]Too Few Minions[/h1]

Some players wanted more minions - a bigger army simply. We're doing our best, but to keep the game working on low-end or mid-tier setups, we have some limitations. We're probably unable to increase counts since low-end machines need to switch off details already. Vastly different counts lead to different games, so we need to have some kind of compromise.

[h1]Hero Visuals Customization[/h1]

This would be awesome to have, but it's a massive feature needing a lot of art and programming. It would probably take most of our time for 1-2 months. We'll try to focus on things we can change the most instead.

[h1]Controls[/h1]

There were some mentions of controls in general and some went to detail about the melee targeting. We found something to be improved in melee targeting at least.

The sector symbol in the game is a bit misleading, since you usually hit one target which is closest to the middle of the sector. We'll be removing the sector indicator and replacing it with some other directional indicator which is clearer. This also helps with the reported minor issue of somewhat unclear necromancer orientation.

[h1]Game Not Ready[/h1]

Rest assured - we're working hard to make it ready :)

Thanks for reading this far! Here's a sneak peek into the change list of the next update which could be out tomorrow:
[list]
[*]Added tutorial for mines

Hi everyone! We have a few pieces of news for this month. I also bring you a gif of this bear showing his undead on/off modes!

We're currently in the midst of closed alpha testing. The wider testing started around Nov 20 and we have 25+ testers playing the game. We're getting feedback constantly and making improvements and fixing bugs every day. Thanks to all the testers so far - keep th feedback coming!

If you'd like to apply to become a tester, visit http://undeadhorde.com and sign up for the newsletter. With this newsletter you'll get news of Undead Horde and some other selected 10tons products. We do not send e-mails very often in any case - usually only about Undead Horde developments and major 10tons events like new games. More importantly: We randomly select people from the list to receive testing invites. 

Originally we wanted to bring the game into early access late November. However, we're roughly 3-4 weeks behind the original schedule and this would have resulted in us releasing the early-access just about now, which is in the midst of the big title holiday marketing season. Which is not desireable. We decided to push the date forwards - after the holidays. Hopefully we find a good date in January.

Also, we're getting a lot of feedback from our testers, so we're already involving people in a smaller scale and we're not developing in the "10tons vacuum" any more in any case. Which is good :)

notes.title: Leveling & Subclasses
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32065038/e629fb6815833e7876e4d15157d6fbadebf92ea0.gif[/img]

In Undead Horde you'll level up as in many games with RPG elements. When leveling up you earn points which you can spend on three different subclasses.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32065038/36489c2d323bb08c44465bbfcce03b229467de8b.png[/img]

Here's our current level up screen. It still needs improvement and polish, but it should give you the basic idea. 

Here you can spend points on various subclasses. Each choice improves the necromancer attributes a bit differently. The choice depends on your desired playstyle. 

If you like to beat the hell out of the enemies the Executioner helps with that. If you'd like to have a large horde, you should spend points on Re-Animator. If you like to cast spells a lot, then spend points on Arcanist. 

You can also mix and match as you will - however some items may have subclass rank requirements so you may need to rank up certain subclass to use them.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32065038/01ff2a2e79eb63d8ce16200c61d211141a6ee245.png[/img]

Here's an example of rank 10 arcanist attributes. Notice the large manapool.

The heart icon represents hit points, the mana potion is mana, the banner is command and the orange impact icon is the damage bonus. Your necromancer attributes will be the sum of the choices you've made along the way.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32065038/2c1a50e639e9ff6bb006ba07b69031543869909b.gif[/img]

Arcanist focused Necromancer wreaking havoc with fireballs. With focus on Arcanist the larger mana pool allows extensive spell attacks.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32065038/72e28e77fc59bc70764bd6a347c96a508f1e56ea.png[/img]

Rank 10 Executioner. The damage bonus is +66% and the hit points are very high.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32065038/e0e46dfd6a74b3e9a7433c6112f054eda97f9f8f.gif[/img]

A necromancer with focus on Executioner showing of his signature weapon - the Scythe.  Even after his horde is gone, he continues to fight since he has some hitpoints to spare.

The Scythe can be very effective as it hits multiple enemies. You need to spend some points on the Executioner subclass to use this weapon.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32065038/e6d42e437ecab7c8f0a162649b770b2c6af5c50c.png[/img]

Rank 10 Re-Animator. Command cap at 41 is much higher than the others.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32065038/83663041398b03b4e7479d769d2480ff9af40746.gif[/img]

In this final image a Re-Animator focused necromancer commands his massive undead archer horde to attack and buffs them with flaming arrows.

notes.title: May Progress Update!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32065038/83ba1d7fa0f57f12e9c2706c5fe8928a96d143e0.gif[/img]

Hello! I was meant to post this a week ago, but was down with the flu for couple days. The summer is short in Finland, this year it was on a Tuesday. However, the sun is a lie, turns out you still need to wear clothing for warmth even though it's nice and pretty outside.

Someone thought it would be a great idea to put a walking tower in the game, so we made an Ent (because that's the closest thing!) and blew through the polygon budget in the process. Just like with regular towers, you need to have a strategy to deal with these guys. Luckily, the Ents are flammable.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32065038/a682599fa5b6bac1b350552aee3e7fee93311f64.gif[/img]

People have been asking about the controls and troop command method. Undead Horde uses WASD/twin-stick controls for the necromancer, allowing you to move and aim/smite independently.

Commanding the horde uses a leash/unleash system. Normally, the horde stays close to you, but you can also release the horde in the aim direction. The white arrows/chevrons in the gifs indicate where the horde was just unleashed. Your horde will then act independently until you choose to recall it.

The system is simple, but works really well in practice, giving you plenty of control over your horde while being intuitive to use with both kbd+mouse and controller.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32065038/554874a7e3adfec41f8804a6edb07ceb6a4d4f2f.gif[/img]

We also came up with a cool progression system, among other things, but that deserves its own update. With that, the game is essentially feature complete, but lots of content and polish are still needed, of course. We are working hard to create an external playable version, but can't commit to a date for that yet.

Also, there are two people from 10tons at Nordic Game 2018 next week. If you want to do an interview, or just want to come say hello, the guys can probably still accommodate you. Feel free to tip off your favorite media outlet! Thanks for reading!

notes.title: Necromancering Tools
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32065038/ed5613124ec8532af1f9e5472ba355d3983f2227.gif[/img]

Hi! This post is about some items and ablities you can use in Undead Horde in addition to raising the dead and commanding your undead army. While your undead army does most of the killing, the necromancer is given some nice personal tools as well.

Our first item is the Staff of Hellfire. It shoots a fireball that sets enemies on fire. It's good against crowds. It doesn't help much with the tower but your minions can handle tower if you keep the angry peasants at bay. It isn't that "necromancery" though, so we may theme it differently in the future.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32065038/b2bd38e9025c3b8db8555a8c78332ab4d7d26df5.gif[/img]

Here the necromancer uses the Circle of Bone. It creates a wall of bone around the necromancer and deals huge damage to everyone inside the wall. The circle of bone protects the necromancer so he can do his re-animating in peace. Once the wall dissipates the necromancer should be prepared to face his foes.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32065038/6e70655d1bcc340d64e38f5f13c27fcf4dace8aa.gif[/img]

This the Wall of Bone. On casting it creates a wall of bone directed at the aiming direction. One tactic is to let your horde handle the front and then flank the enemy with the bony wall from the side. Necromancer raises some chickens here - they'll be useful in the next demonstration...

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32065038/5739bc3a899388a76a0508d14f85c362bed52278.gif[/img]

Here the necromancer uses the Sceptre of Explosion. It will detonate a unit in your army nearest the enemy. Chickens are plentiful but they can only do little damage against a tower before dying. Using an Sceptre of Explosion on them turns them into clucking bombs which can be very effective!

Thanks for reading!

notes.title: The Chickening
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32065038/7816f539f11605d4f184ea7d147321b8fb444524.gif[/img]

Today, we introduce an unsung hero of the battlefield, the Chicken. While usually an unwilling participant in the conflict between the dead and the living, the Chicken is a ferocious opponent when provoked.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32065038/8ea9c7db6ca7bd483f77d4da3ac076d1908ceb52.gif[/img]

The Chicken end up in the horde due to their unlucky association with humans, and the Necromancer isn’t picky when it comes to fresh corpses. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32065038/0bfbfba450b21a20f82f1cfe88719d31f39e0267.gif[/img]

Being numerous and expendable, the Chicken are useful in many ways. They’re a perfect target for the Explosion ability - especially when combined with Multiply (which creates short-lived copies of your minions)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32065038/b33e7bb4d6cbb302a5fa8104a7193fd6aeab7c43.gif[/img]

Thanks for reading! Visit www.undeadhorde.com and follow us on social media for more news on Undead Horde and other 10tons games.

notes.title: Progress Update!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32065038/d8b8cf65c02cf3e083fc2f8490218134050036d4.jpg[/img]

Hi!

It has been over a month since the last update, so we wanted to share the current progress with you. We are not used to posting regular updates, it’s a bit of an adjustment, so thank you for reading this!

First of all, we did a lot of work on gameplay and visuals over the past month. Rampaging through the countryside is now much more pleasant of an experience. The trailer and screenshots have been updated to reflect the current state of the game, so go take a look if you haven’t already!

The next big task is to polish the meat-and-potatoes RPG systems like items, abilities, leveling, and quests. We are currently thinking of keeping the necromancer in more of a semi-support role, using crowd control abilities like the bone wall shown in the new trailer. You are commanding this massive legion of the dead after all, so might as well enable the grunts to do most of the killing. 

That being said, we are not going to neglect traditional hammer/sword/axe/dagger swinging, so don’t worry. And since the game is still so early in development, it would be interesting to hear what you would like to do in this game. Let us know what you think!

notes.title: Scroll of Multiplication
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32065038/e533caa80b42e575b5bd61001eaed77469eccb92.png[/img]

We have this item called "Scroll of Multiplication". It is quite fun, but at the moment somewhat "unbalanced". The scroll of multiplication multiplies your units by 10. 

Here we used 3 of them in a row so: 10*10*10=1000!

The actual gameplay version of this function will have certain limits on which units are multiplied and how powerful the multiplied units are. The current results are amusing even though not viable as a final mechanic.
